status: frozen before authoring; only derived TEST properties are added at the freeze

order.algorithm: holdout-order.v1: the cells sorted by the hex SHA-256 of '<seed>:<cell_id>', ascending; no other input

omission_audit.algorithm: holdout-omission.v1: strata (planned type, planned acts); each gets round(12 x its share) by largest remainder, ties by the hex SHA-256 of '<seed>:<stratum>'; within a stratum the cells with the lowest hex SHA-256 of '<seed>:<cell_id>'

construction.resume: same cell, need, stage and frozen inputs; admitted outputs never run again
construction.statement_review: code and blind roles only; no person edits or approves a statement

evidence_discovery.first_judgment: search A's label where A listed the node, else search B's, else search C's; the answerability, search A's
evidence_discovery.audit_threshold: a node new to search C adjudicated grade >= 1 stops

answer_fields.name: answer_fields
answer_fields.rule: the complete contract of the answer before it is admitted (ingest/holdout_admission.py, P1 #1): the fields its consumers read, with their types and non-empty text (a concept, its facts as a list of text, the fit; a statement; a verdict from the gatekeeper's list naming only a need it was shown)

broker_ceiling.name: broker_ceiling
broker_ceiling.rule: 32 requests are the technical ceiling (ingest/holdout_broker.py, Codex Gate 2 P1.3)

broker_protocol.name: broker_protocol
broker_protocol.rule: the third invalid reply ends the run (ingest/holdout_broker.py, D-054)

concept_no_dev_wording.name: concept_no_dev_wording
concept_no_dev_wording.rule: D-054's frozen guard on an author's packet (ingest/holdout_packets.py author_leaks: no legal wording and no run of eight words of DEV or the fixtures), unchanged, on the statement writer's packet: when the concept's own words make it fire (the packet built without them passes), the concept is no valid TEST concept. The attempt closes, never retried, and the cell gets a new blind attempt that learns nothing of it (CONSTRUCTION_AMENDMENT_1)

dataset_records.name: dataset_records
dataset_records.rule: the benchmark's own validators accept the need with every ready one (ingest/benchmark.py dataset_problems)

diagnostic_admissible.name: diagnostic_admissible
diagnostic_admissible.rule: an answer of Qwen3-8B, from a run that ended normally under the frozen runtime, is a diagnostic only if it is one JSON object grading every candidate once with the protocol's labels (ingest/holdout_judging.py diagnostic_defects), and a prompt that does not fit the frozen limit is never generated (input_exceeds_context, P1 #6); otherwise the diagnostic is unavailable: the answer stays with its run, never read again, with no vote and no label, and a blind judge D grades every candidate and the answerability by the rule of a discrepancy. Unavailable is not agreement. Greedy decoding gives the same answer again, so it is never executed again (the first START, aborted on 2026-10-20 with no ready need)

diagnostic_preflight.name: diagnostic_preflight
diagnostic_preflight.rule: the diagnostic's record carries the token count of its prompt, made by the frozen tokenizer and chat template before any generation, against the frozen limit, and a generation exactly when the prompt fits (P1 #6)

evidence_overlap_stratum.name: evidence_overlap_stratum
evidence_overlap_stratum.rule: shared grade-3 evidence with DEV is a stratum for S4, not an exclusion; only the evidence gatekeeper's verdict decides (D-054)

execution_deadline.name: execution_deadline
execution_deadline.rule: every execution is bounded (ingest/holdout_process.py, P1 #7): at its deadline its process group gets SIGTERM, a grace period, SIGKILL, is reaped and verified gone; only then is the failed execution recorded, and another may follow

final_qrels_unambiguous.name: final_qrels_unambiguous
final_qrels_unambiguous.rule: PROTOCOL.md v1.4 section 4: an ambiguous need leaves TEST and is replaced blind

judge_answer_complete.name: judge_answer_complete
judge_answer_complete.rule: the complete contract of a search's or a judge's answer before it is admitted (ingest/holdout_admission.py, P1 #1): every candidate graded once and only the candidates, every item answered once, grades 0 to 3, true or false ambiguity, an answerability of the protocol, the rationale every label needs, the gap note a partial or none answerability needs, each label one the adjudication record can hold, and the protocol's rules on a search's file (judge_a_problems); a search that declares a problem needs its text only. The diagnostic's is diagnostic_admissible

material_discrepancy.name: material_discrepancy
material_discrepancy.rule: Qwen3-8B has no vote: a material discrepancy only sends the item to judge D (D-054 decision 7)

metadata_answer.name: metadata_answer
metadata_answer.rule: a type, difficulty and drivers from the rubric (ingest/holdout_judging.py final_metadata)

model_identity.name: model_identity
model_identity.rule: the effective model the authenticated runtime reports in the session is, exactly, the one frozen from Gate 1 (ingest/holdout_runtime.py claude_problems)

packet_construction.name: packet_construction
packet_construction.rule: a packet the code builds from frozen inputs and admitted outputs before a model sees it: a frozen input that no longer holds (the protocol's sections and examples, the attempt frames, a template), a node the corpus lacks, or the anti-copy guard firing on the frozen parts alone. No execution can change it: the construction stops for a person (CONSTRUCTION_AMENDMENT_1)

plan_deviation.name: plan_deviation
plan_deviation.rule: the grid is a target, not a quota: departures are recorded (D-054 decision 8)

process_cleanup.name: process_cleanup
process_cleanup.rule: a process group that cannot be verified gone after SIGKILL: no execution may follow it, the stage is pending_technical_unresolved and the construction stops for a person (ingest/holdout_process.py, P1 #7)

qrel_texts.name: qrel_texts
qrel_texts.rule: every qrel names a node of the corpus with its text (ingest/benchmark.py qrel_problems)

query_formulations.name: query_formulations
query_formulations.rule: query_variants.v1: exactly the three formulations, one per line

record_assembly.name: record_assembly
record_assembly.rule: the records the code assembles from admitted outputs (the draft and final need and queries, the adjudications and qrels with their gap notes, the evidence pairs, the ledger's transitions) hold the dataset's schema and the ledger's sequence. No execution can change them: the construction stops for a person (CONSTRUCTION_AMENDMENT_1)

reply_is_json.name: reply_is_json
reply_is_json.rule: every packet asks for one JSON object (the role templates); the diagnostic's own answer is diagnostic_admissible's

role_audit.name: role_audit
role_audit.rule: each run against its role contract: authorized input, orchestrator messages, runtime context (ingest/holdout_roles.py, Codex Gate 2 P1.1)

runtime_identity.name: runtime_identity
runtime_identity.rule: the diagnostic was produced under the frozen MLX runtime, recorded in its spool before the run and in the output itself (ingest/holdout_runtime.py local_problems)

semantic_admissibility.name: semantic_admissibility
semantic_admissibility.rule: the person's rule of 2026-10-21: an answer that ended normally, passed its audit and has the right form, but violates a frozen semantic invariant tying its labels to the need's evidence or answerability (the metadata's type, gap drivers, negation and drivers against the final grades; a search's answerability against its own grades: ingest/holdout_admission.py), is one failed technical execution; when the stage's three executions all violate the same invariant (the check and its codes, never the text), the need or its adjudication cannot give an admissible answer: the attempt is rejected, nothing is inferred, repaired or substituted, and the cell gets a new blind attempt (at most three). A failure of the role's contract (form, fields, types, vocabulary, a reference it was not shown) stays technical, and so does search C's, whose audit cells get no rejection the others do not get

state_integrity.name: state_integrity
state_integrity.rule: the durable state verifies and equals what the replay rebuilds (ingest/holdout_state.py, D-055)

statement_cites_no_provision.name: statement_cites_no_provision
statement_cites_no_provision.rule: PROTOCOL.md step 1: a statement names no article, paragraph, point, structural unit, node path or CELEX (ingest/benchmark.py render_query_prompt)

statement_no_dev_wording.name: statement_no_dev_wording
statement_no_dev_wording.rule: D-054: no legal wording and no run of eight words of DEV or the fixtures (ingest/holdout_packets.py author_leaks)

unclassified_failure.name: unclassified_failure
unclassified_failure.rule: any failure the construction does not classify is recorded as a stop for a person before the process ends, naming its kind and place, never its text; only a failure of the state itself (integrity, identities, lock, a replay's refused write) or of its medium leaves it unwritten

role_verdicts.verdict: a problem with the need, before any of its candidates is read
role_verdicts.rule: judge_a.v2: search B is part of every need's evidence, under search A's rule

role_verdicts.verdict: does not hold the final label, or finds the item ambiguous

stop_rules: an omission found by the audit's search C, new to the union of searches A and B, adjudicated grade >= 1 (Codex Gate 2 P1.4; config/holdout/evidence-discovery.md)
the audit's search C declares a problem: the audit cannot be completed (omission_audit_incomplete, before any of its candidates is read)
a process group not verified gone after SIGKILL (process_cleanup)
a failure the construction does not classify (unclassified_failure)
fewer than 50 evaluable needs still reachable (D-054 decision 3)
a problem found at an operational checkpoint (D-055)
a technical stage failed three executions: pending_technical_unresolved (D-055)

changes_since_e_result.ingest/decomposition.py: adds assemble_scored (G1, iteration 5); assemble, E's rule, unchanged
changes_since_e_result.ingest/ir_metrics.py: adds binary_scores (T4); the graded measures unchanged
changes_since_e_result.ingest/lexical.py: adds the Italian analyzer of T4; the English and Porter branch is equivalent, and tests/unit/test_lexical.py keeps the DEV config hash e086bdb4

E5.scoring: dot product of the normalized mean-pooled vectors (its similarity)
E5.ranking: score descending, then chunk id ascending (ingest/retrieval.py rank_by_scores)
E5.depth: every chunk of the layer, at least ingest/evaluation.MIN_RUN_DEPTH

BM25.corpus_unit: the chunk_text of every chunk of the layer
BM25.ranking: score descending, then chunk id ascending (ingest/retrieval.py rank_by_scores)

E.rule: D's rule on each requirement's first 50 E5 chunks reordered by the reranker
E.d_rule: E5's first 6; places 7 to 10 to corroborated E5 ranks 7 to 10, then each requirement's best chunk outside E5's top 10 in turns, then the rest of E5's 7 to 10; the 10 in E5's order (K = 5)

decomposer.unreadable: fewer than 2 readable requirements keep E5's ranking

config.name: qwen3-reranker-0.6b
config.prefix:
<|im_start|>system
Judge whether the Document meets the requirements based on the Query and the Instruct provided. Note that the answer can only be "yes" or "no".<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user

reranker.instruction: Given a question about EU financial regulation, retrieve the passages of the law that answer it
reranker.order: descending score; equal scores keep E5's order

assembler.after_the_ten: the rest of E5's ranking, in E5's order

evaluation.relevance: binary at grade >= 2; nDCG uses the grades as linear gains
evaluation.evaluable: needs of answerability complete or partial; none never enters a metric
evaluation.aggregation: each metric per query, the mean over a need's queries (its three formulations: EN formal, EN natural, ES natural), then the mean over the evaluable needs: ingest/retrieval.py macro_by_need and ingest/run_report.py paired_bootstrap, the computation of M-049's +0.061
evaluation.aggregation_note: D-020 calls this global value descriptive because it mixes languages; S4 makes it primary by the S3 decision that the statistical unit is the need, and reports the languages as secondary strata
evaluation.missing_rankings: a query absent from a run is scored 0 and listed (evaluation.py)

bootstrap.interval: percentile: sorted means at int(0.025 * reps) and int(0.975 * reps) - 1
bootstrap.resampling: needs with replacement (random.Random(seed).choices), each need's delta the mean over its queries

analysis.effect_size: d_z = mean of the per-need deltas / their standard deviation (n - 1)

aborted_runs.reason: The frozen Qwen diagnostic recovery policy assumed that a repeated technical execution could produce a different semantic output. In the real S3 run Qwen3-8B was running greedy deterministic decoding, so a structurally malformed but successfully generated response was likely reproducible. Retrying the identical semantic execution was therefore not a meaningful recovery strategy.
aborted_runs.change: the diagnostic's failure semantics only (holdout_checks.py diagnostic_admissible); sampling, grid, order, prompts, judges and systems unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: The omission audit's hard stop: a second blind search found evidence judge A had missed, adjudicated grade >= 1, so that the frozen rule called for the evidence search to be corrected for every need alike. The review that followed also found control-flow defects (outputs admitted without their full contract, a second searcher's declared problem with no transition, audits bound to the wrong attempt, unbounded processes, a controller that could act on a stale failure). The run is kept whole as a protocol-development run, and TEST restarts prospectively under one final procedure for every need, rather than being repaired.
aborted_runs.change: evidence discovery: two blind searches for every need, their union adjudicated once, and the omission audit as a third blind search (config/holdout/evidence-discovery.md); complete admission of every output; bounded processes with verified cleanup; the diagnostic's token preflight; every reachable failure classified (config/holdout/failure-paths.md); the unattended controller in the repository. Sampling, grid, order, omission cells, templates, judges, thresholds, systems and the S4 metrics unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: Three independent executions of the metadata adjudicator gave a well-formed answer violating the same frozen semantic rule of its stage, so that technical retries could not repair it and the stage was left pending_technical_unresolved. The transition for that class was defined prospectively, and TEST restarts under it.
aborted_runs.change: a semantic admissibility failure, the same frozen invariant violated in the three executions of search A, search B or the metadata adjudicator, rejects the attempt (semantic_inadmissible); contract failures and search C keep their technical exhaustion. Everything else unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: Three executions of judge C answered the item they were given for another legal node, a failure of the role's contract, so that the stage was left pending_technical_unresolved. A candidate's identity was carried by its act and path, which the model wrote back itself, rather than by an id the orchestrator owns.
aborted_runs.change: the identity of what a judge grades: every candidate of judges B, C and D and of the diagnostic is given under an opaque item id, answered by that exact id and mapped to its node by the orchestrator alone (judge_b.v2, judge_c.v2, judge_d.v2); a missing, unknown, repeated or other id stays a technical contract failure. Rubrics, thresholds, retries and every methodological rule unchanged
